comments.body:
Peter Matthew Eichman may be able to work this ticket early to mid-August, 2016.
See: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/fedora-tech/eyWmkebQZyg/gpmDb6C_BwAJ

Latest discussion has resulted in the choice to simply remove the "fedora:numberOfChildren" triple completely.
See: http://irclogs.fcrepo.org/2016-07-07.html @16:27

Jared Whiklo? Esmé Cowles? Unknown? would you mind giving this a review?
I have tested it on a dataset containing 5million+ resources off of the root, and a top-level GET request returned in ~4min.
